claims.content: To capture the details of voucher sales between MISU sales team and Distributors, including distributor-wise and salesman-wise information, to facilitate the distribution process and generate reports.

goal.raw_text: To capture the details of voucher sales between MISU sales team and Distributors, including distributor-wise and salesman-wise information, to facilitate the distribution process and generate reports.

claims.content: VMU User
The VMU has created vouchers with unique identification numbers and security protocols.
Distributor master information (including Distributor Code, Name, Address, etc.) has been captured in the system.
MSIU Sales Team Information Master (including Salesman Code, Name, etc.) has been captured in the system.
Vouchers are available in stock for distribution.
The VMU user initiates the process to record a voucher distribution transaction from the MISU sales team to a distributor.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU user initiates the process to record a voucher distribution transaction from the MISU sales team to a distributor.

main_flow.content: The VMU User initiates the 'Distribution Transaction' module within the system.
The system displays a form to capture distribution details.
The VMU User selects the 'Name of the distributor' from the existing Distributor Master list.
The VMU User selects the 'Name of the Sales Man' from the existing Salesman Master list.
The VMU User enters or selects the 'Date of Distribution'.
The VMU User enters the 'Required Qty' (Number of vouchers required by the distributor). The system validates that this is a numeric entry.
The system automatically calculates the 'Invoice Amount' based on the formula: Whole Sale Rate (from settings master) * Qty Sold.
The VMU User selects the 'Mode of payment' (e.g., Cash).
The system generates an auto-generated 'Distribution Invoice No'.
While entering the quantity, the system automatically picks available Batch Numbers and corresponding Voucher Numbers from the voucher stock.
The system displays the details of each allocated voucher (Batch No, Voucher No, Validity Date) in a grid format for confirmation.
The VMU User reviews the transaction details and confirms the distribution.
The system saves the distribution transaction, updates the voucher status to 'Distributed', and reduces the available stock.
The system allows the user to view, print, or generate reports based on the recorded distribution (e.g., Distributor-wise, Salesman-wise, Batch-wise sales details).
